tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant pyuria, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL. Hematuria and mild proteinuria are also present. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No casts were seen, which argues against upper tract involvement. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
